messages:
natalie: Heads up, booking issue. Booked a refundable hotel through our travel vendor but the vendor charged an extra booking fee that I cant find in the policy. Should that fee be reimbursable? cc @omar

omar: If the fee is a vendor service fee (booking platform fee) and not part of the lodging nightly rate or taxes, we generally do not reimburse it unless pre-approved by your manager. Exceptions: if the fee was required to secure a room due to last-minute constraints and manager approves afterwards.

omar: Send a short note in the expense explaining why the fee was charged and include the vendor invoice line. If manager approves, we'll mark it reimbursable.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: policy states "standard lodging rates, taxes, and mandatory resort fees are reimbursable; third-party booking fees are not reimbursable without approval."

natalie: ok i'll ping my manager for sign-off and attach the vendor invoice. thanks!
